cat <<'EOF' | sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/setup-datavg-loop.sh
#!/bin/sh
set -e
IMG=/var/lib/lvm-backing/disk1.img
if ! losetup -j "$IMG" | grep -q /dev/loop; then
    losetup -f "$IMG"
fi
vgchange -ay datavg
EOF
sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/setup-datavg-loop.sh
cat /usr/local/sbin/setup-datavg-loop.sh

[Unit]

After=systemd-udevd.service
Before=lvm2-activation-early.service lvm2-activation.service local-fs-pre.target

[Service]

ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/setup-datavg-loop.sh

[Install]
